frames.prompt: A young soldier leans out of a moving train door, grinning, one arm raised high. On the platform his mother stands still with both hands on her bag and does not wave. 135mm from far down the platform, iron columns stacked flat between them. Low sun from behind the train, dust hanging in it. Documentary still, visible grain.

own.s: a young soldier grinning from a moving train door, his mother still on the platform
own.l: low sun behind the train, dust over the platform

frames.prompt: S: a young woman laughing behind a barred train window, palm flat on the glass; her father outside, jaw tight, eyes down. L: green tube light inside the coach, blue dusk on the platform. A: 135mm, eye level, shot through a passing crowd. T: blue hour. E: melancholy, a romance told from the father's side.

own.s: a daughter laughing behind a train window, her father outside
own.l: green tube light in the coach, blue dusk on the platform

frames.prompt: EXT. SMALL TOWN STATION, DAWN. The last coach pulls out. A boy of twelve presses against the window bars, waving with both hands, shouting something happy. Foreground, soft: the back of his grandfather's head and one raised hand. 135mm, low angle from the platform edge. Sun rising behind the train, fields beyond.

own.s: a boy waving from the last coach window, his grandfather on the platform

frames.prompt: Light first: flat grey monsoon sky, no shadows, a wet platform giving back a dull sheen. In it, an old woman in a white sari sits at the train door with a cloth bundle, beaming like a child. Her three grown sons stand in a row below, all crying. 135mm, eye level, faces stacked close by the long lens. Calm, observational.

own.s: an old woman leaving on a pilgrimage, beaming, her sons in tears
own.l: flat grey monsoon light on a wet platform

frames.prompt: 135mm, wide open, so the platform lights melt into discs. Two friends in their twenties: one steps up into the coach with a guitar case on his back, laughing over his shoulder; the other stays on the platform, hands in pockets, half lit by a red signal lamp. Night. Film noir mood, deep blacks, one colour accent.

own.s: two friends on a night platform, the one with the guitar boarding and laughing

frames.prompt: He got the job in the city. That is why he is smiling. A thin man in a checked shirt stands in the train door holding a steel trunk, smiling down. own.l: hard noon sun on bleached concrete

frames.prompt: Black and white. Over her shoulder, out of focus in the foreground: a woman's turned-away cheek and one earring. own.s: a man boarding with a smile while the woman he leaves turns away
own.l: sodium platform lamps reflected along the coach windows

frames.prompt: Composition: the frame is mostly empty platform, pale concrete crossed by long column shadows. Top left, a train sliding out, one arm waving from a door, a white grin just readable. Bottom right, one small figure standing very still. High angle from the footbridge on a 135mm. First light of dawn, backlit haze. Melancholy.

own.s: one arm waving from a train, one figure alone on an emptied platform

frames.prompt: Palette: faded turquoise coach, mustard scarf, grey sky, nothing else saturated. A student with a backpack bends down from the coach step, laughing, while her grandmother holds her face and kisses her forehead. own.s: a student laughing as her grandmother kisses her forehead at the coach door

frames.prompt: railway platform, golden hour, backlit, a small brown dog sitting at the platform edge seen from behind and low, ears up, 135mm telephoto, beyond it a departing train with a man leaning out, laughing, calling to the dog, long shadows, dust, shallow focus on the dog, longing, documentary photograph, film grain

frames.prompt: No full faces. Frame only this: two hands at the edge of a train door, an older hand with glass bangles letting go of a younger one. frames.prompt: Light first: a low dawn sun directly behind the stall, turning every thread of steam white. Through the steam, a kettle spout and one sleeve reaching for the first glass.
